title: Jack N. and Lillian R. Berkman Professor for Entrepreneurial Legal Studies
bio: Yochai Benkler is the Berkman Professor of Entrepreneurial Legal Studies at Harvard Law School, where he is faculty director of the Program on Law and Political Economy and a co-director of the Berkman Klein Center for Internet and Society. Since the 1990s, he has written about the political economy of digital technologies, focusing on how […]
